title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
authors_or_org: Michael Ahn et al.; Google Robotics / Everyday Robots
claims: LLM relevance and affordance scores select executable skills; original feedback limitations; tabletop release.
limitations: Public simulation is not the complete real mobile manipulation stack.

title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
authors_or_org: Danny Driess et al.; Google / TU Berlin
claims: Continuous observations inserted as language-space embeddings; text plans; joint multimodal training.
limitations: Text planning is not direct servo control.

title: VIMA: General Robot Manipulation with Multimodal Prompts
authors_or_org: Yunfan Jiang et al.; Stanford / NVIDIA and collaborators
claims: Object-centric multimodal prompting, T5 and cross-attention decoder; 600K+ trajectories; four-level generalization.
limitations: Primarily procedural tabletop simulation.

title: EmbodiedGPT: Vision-Language Pre-Training via Embodied Chain of Thought
claims: EgoCOT, prefix-tuned 7B language model, planning features for control.
limitations: Embodied benchmarks do not prove arbitrary real-world control.

title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
authors_or_org: Wenlong Huang et al.; Stanford / UIUC
claims: Language-generated code composes geometry-grounded value maps; motion planning and feedback.
limitations: Depends on perception, planning assumptions and system integration.

title: R3M: A Universal Visual Representation for Robot Manipulation
authors_or_org: Suraj Nair, Aravind Rajeswaran, Vikash Kumar, Chelsea Finn, Abhinav Gupta
claims: Ego4D visual pretraining with temporal and language alignment; frozen-feature policy learning.
limitations: Encoder is not a complete policy or dynamics model.

title: Where are we in the search for an Artificial Visual Cortex for Embodied Intelligence?
authors_or_org: Arjun Majumdar et al.; Meta and collaborators
claims: VC-1 MAE pretraining; CortexBench 17 tasks; adaptation changes downstream performance.
limitations: Cross-domain conclusions depend on adaptation and downstream training.

title: Perceiver-Actor: A Multi-Task Transformer for Robotic Manipulation
authors_or_org: Mohit Shridhar, Lucas Manuelli, Dieter Fox
claims: Voxel observation-action alignment; Perceiver; discretized 6-DoF keyposes; 18 RLBench tasks.
limitations: Voxel cost and calibrated RGB-D requirements.

title: RVT: Robotic View Transformer for 3D Object Manipulation
claims: Virtual-view rendering and cross-view attention; direct comparison with PerAct.
limitations: Speedups refer to specified implementation and matched performance.

title: 3D Diffuser Actor: Policy Diffusion with 3D Scene Representations
authors_or_org: Tsung-Wei Ke, Nikolaos Gkanatsios, Katerina Fragkiadaki
claims: Diffusion over end-effector poses conditioned on 3D relative attention.
limitations: An action policy, not a video simulator.

title: 3D Diffuser Actor official implementation
authors_or_org: Tsung-Wei Ke, Nikolaos Gkanatsios and collaborators
claims: Weights and evaluation scripts; quaternion format correction; benchmark protocol details.
limitations: Repository updates can differ from original published results.

title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
authors_or_org: Danijar Hafner, Jurgis Pasukonis, Jimmy Ba, Timothy Lillicrap
claims: DreamerV3 latent imagination, actor-critic learning and robust normalization.
limitations: Shared configuration does not mean shared zero-shot weights.

title: Mastering diverse control tasks through world models
claims: Nature publication of DreamerV3 lineage and diverse control evaluation.
limitations: Full publisher page encountered redirect restriction; abstract/indexed text checked alongside arXiv.

title: UniSim: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
authors_or_org: Sherry Yang et al.; UC Berkeley / Google DeepMind / MIT
claims: Action-conditioned interactive experiences train planners and low-level RL policies.
limitations: Shown transfer is task-specific; unrelated to namesake driving sensor simulator.

title: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators
claims: Heterogeneous datasets support conditional video simulation and robot policy learning.
limitations: Generative artifacts and long-horizon action fidelity limit extrapolation.

title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
authors_or_org: Jake Bruce et al.; Google DeepMind
claims: Video tokenizer, latent action model and dynamics; action-label-free interaction learning.
limitations: Latent actions are not calibrated physical motor commands.

title: Genie 2: A large-scale foundation world model
claims: Autoregressive latent diffusion conditioned on historical frames and actions.
limitations: Generated interactive worlds are not validated physical robot controllers.

title: Genie 3: A new frontier for world models
authors_or_org: Jack Parker-Holder and Shlomi Fruchter; Google DeepMind
claims: 720p, 24fps, minutes of interaction; explicitly limited action space and multi-agent fidelity.
limitations: Full architecture and dataset not disclosed in checked page.

title: Project Genie: Experiment with infinite, interactive worlds
claims: User-facing prototype exposes a subset of Genie 3 capabilities.
limitations: Availability is gated; prototype omits some research capabilities.

title: Unleashing Large-Scale Video Generative Pre-training for Visual Robot Manipulation
claims: GR-1 jointly predicts future images and robot actions from language, images and state.
limitations: Joint prediction does not establish explicit inference-time planning.

title: GR-1 project: Unleashing Large-Scale Video Generative Pre-training for Visual Robot Manipulation
claims: Video pretraining and policy adaptation; CALVIN and robot demonstrations.
limitations: Benchmark and embodiment-specific evidence.

title: GR-2: A Generative Video-Language-Action Model with Web-Scale Knowledge for Robot Manipulation
claims: 38 million clips, 50 billion-plus tokens, joint video-action adaptation.
limitations: 97.7% success is author task-suite aggregate, not open-world guarantee.

title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
authors_or_org: Mahmoud Assran et al.; Meta FAIR
claims: Video latent prediction and action-conditioned robot adaptation using less than 62 hours DROID.
limitations: Zero-shot refers to deployment environment; action data is used during post-training.

title: Introducing V-JEPA 2
claims: Latent understanding/prediction and image-goal robot planning.
limitations: Small robot tasks do not establish broad physical competence.

title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
authors_or_org: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia et al.; Meta FAIR
claims: Dense/deep supervision; Table 6 shows 60-to-70 grasp success at 3s and 80 at 14s.
limitations: Ten test tasks per skill; longer planning changes compute budget; gripper failures remain.

title: V-JEPA 2, 2-AC and 2.1 official code and checkpoints
claims: 2.1 release and models; action-conditioned code; exact checkpoint families.
limitations: Code and weights availability does not imply full data release.

title: Supported Models: NVIDIA NIM for Cosmos WFM
claims: Predict2.5 text/image/video-to-world; Transfer2.5 conditioned transformation.
limitations: Version-specific hardware requirements; not a robot policy.

title: Cosmos Policy: Fine-Tuning Video Models for Visuomotor Control and Planning
authors_or_org: Moo Jin Kim et al.; NVIDIA / Stanford
claims: Predict2-2B initialized joint latent-frame action, state, value model; optional best-of-N planning.
limitations: Direct-policy and planning modes have different resource and data requirements.

title: Develop Physical AI Reasoning, World, and Action Models with NVIDIA Cosmos 3
authors_or_org: Asawaree Bhide and Alexander Schwarz; NVIDIA
claims: Mixture-of-Transformers reasoning and generation towers; Nano and Super releases.
limitations: Initial release post is older than current Edge-inclusive repository.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos official repository
claims: Super64B/Nano16B/Edge4B; DROID policies; Edge limits; current OpenMDW-1.1 license.
limitations: Mode- and hardware-specific latency; complete pretraining reproduction not implied.

title: GAIA-2: A Controllable Multi-View Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving
claims: Multiview action/condition-guided driving world model.
limitations: Driving data and sensors; not general manipulation.

title: Wayve launches GAIA-3, advancing world models from simulation to evaluation
claims: World-model evolution toward driving evaluation.
limitations: Official system claim; no open checkpoint verified.

title: GAIA-4: Multimodal World Models Powering Closed-Loop Simulation for Safe and Scalable Autonomy
claims: AI Driver closed loop; camera/radar generation; world-on-rails and optional reactive agents.
limitations: Network and training details not fully disclosed; counterfactual assumptions matter.

title: MoLe-VLA: Dynamic Layer-skipping Vision Language Action Model via Mixture-of-Layers for Efficient Robot Manipulation
claims: Dynamic VLA layer routing and cognitive self-distillation.
limitations: Efficiency method, not world-model dynamics or video simulation.

title: Cosmos Policy official implementation
claims: Public implementation, checkpoints/data links, direct and planning resource requirements.
limitations: Planning and training consume more compute than the direct policy.

title: GR-2: A Generative Video-Language-Action Model with Web-Scale Knowledge for Robot Manipulation (full text)
claims: Explicit GR-1 extension; 97.7% is the 105-task Simple setting; unseen-manipulation results are lower.
limitations: Different generalization settings must not be combined into one universal success claim.
